title: Enzyme Engine — Enzymes & Vitamins
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B enzymes (Chapter 11) from 5 main options: Enzyme Basics (key terms, tap-to-label the active site, substrate and allosteric site, lock-and-key vs induced fit, activation energy diagrams, specificity), Classify Enzymes (the six classes from a reaction or from name clues like decarboxylase, kinase, synthetase), Enzyme Activity (read temperature, pH, substrate and enzyme graphs; predict how the rate changes), Inhibitors & Control (competitive, noncompetitive, irreversible, heavy metals, feedback, allosteric control, covalent modification, zymogens, health and dental connections), and Cofactors & Vitamins (metal ions, B vitamins to coenzymes, deficiency diseases, water- vs fat-soluble). Skill Check Prep gives 10 questions and a study plan; Exam Practice has 79 final-exam style questions. Mistake-specific feedback, step-by-step help, a cheat sheet, XP, ranks, 12 achievements and Enzo the enzyme mascot.
